messages.author: rosaester.forgione.unina.it
messages.body:
Good morning,
I need to perform an MD simulation of an oligosaccharide with some
modification not included in glycam. I tried to build a library for
the sugar bearing an N-acetylation instead of the standard O-
acetylation. However I am not able to get the parameters for the
oligosaccharide even when i load the library corresponding to the
modified sugar. Is there another way to accomplish this? Any
suggestion is welcome. Thanks a lot
